dotnetSdk.authority: ADR-0001 sections 4-5 select C# on .NET 10 LTS; ADR-0012 section 22 requires global.json to pin the SDK version or accepted roll-forward policy.
dotnetSdk.pinningPolicy: BOOT-001 should create global.json for .NET 10 LTS using an exact installed 10.0 SDK patch or an approved latestFeature roll-forward policy. The exact patch is owner-controlled at bootstrap time.

githubActionsRunner.authority: ADR-0006 selects Windows x64 as the first fully supported MVP platform; ADR-0011 selects Windows x64 installer delivery; ADR-0012 supports Windows validation and packaging.
githubActionsRunner.scope: Smallest initial Windows desktop MVP bootstrap runner. Multi-platform CI is deferred until explicitly required by a later pipeline stage.

pipelineStages.name: restore
pipelineStages.purpose: Restore .NET dependencies using central package management.

pipelineStages.name: build
forbiddenDependencies: generated source that is not reproducible or committed by policy

pipelineStages.name: architecture-tests
acceptanceCriteria: Fails for ADR-0043 forbidden reference examples.

pipelineStages.name: unit-and-contract-tests
pipelineStages.purpose: Run unit, contract, persistence, provider, Rule Set, desktop, and end-to-end tests by maturity.
forbiddenDependencies: live provider calls in default CI
acceptanceCriteria: Initial empty/smoke tests pass; later suites expand by boundary.

pipelineStages.name: provenance-and-secret-scans
pipelineStages.purpose: Scan secrets, dependency licenses, package provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Fails on committed secrets or missing required provenance.

pipelineStages.name: package-artifact-build
pipelineStages.purpose: Build package artifacts only in release workflow after validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Build artifact is not published unless release workflow authorizes distribution.

pipelineStages.name: installer-build
pipelineStages.purpose: Build Windows installer for release workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Installer includes required license and notice inventory.

issues.summary: Exact CI runner OS and .NET SDK version must match ADR-0001 and ADR-0012 at bootstrap time.
issues.impact: Resolved for BOOT-001 planning as .NET 10 LTS with Windows-only initial runner. Exact SDK patch remains owner-controlled at bootstrap file creation.
